page.layout: One printed page: title page. Large title block at top centred; a woodcut emblem (oval vignette with the motto "EST VIA ... INVIA ... VIRTVTI ... ALTA" around it) in the centre; imprint lines below the woodcut, ending with the date and privilege line at the foot. No margin text.

main_text.l: Cum gratia & priuilegio S. Cæsar. Maiestat. ad decennium.

page.notes: The woodcut emblem carries a curved motto around its oval border, partly illegible in the scan (fragments "EST VIA", "INVIA", "VIRTVTI", "ALTA"); not transcribed as text. The imprint line "Cum gratia..." is partly damaged at its left edge; "Maiestat" and "decennium" are only partly legible. "Guiliemi" is printed as such. The "Apud" line is slightly obscured at its start.
